title: 국방정신전력원령 / queue:ADDENDUM:26771:20151230:00001:part:1/1
full_text:
ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 26771, Dec. 30, 2015>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date) This Decree enters into force on January 1, 2016.

Article 2 (Amendments to Other Statutes)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Defense Reform is partially amended as follows:

Subparagraph 20 is newly inserted in Article 19 (1) as follows:

20. Director of the Armed Forces Institute for Military Spirit.

(2) The Decree on the Joint Forces Military University is partially amended as follows:

In Article 1, "military spirit (精神戰力) and foreign languages" is replaced with "foreign languages".

Subparagraph 2-2 of Article 2 is deleted.

Article 4-2 (2) and (3) are respectively replaced with the following:

(2) The Defense Language Institute shall be established under the Joint Forces Military University and shall perform duties concerning foreign-language education necessary for joint and combined operations and international military exchanges.

(3) The Head of the Defense Language Institute shall be appointed from among field-grade officers or civilian military officials employed under contract.

In Article 4-2 (4), "units and the Armed Forces Institute for Military Spirit" is replaced, in each instance, with "units".
